name: Lepine-Pauline
desc: A self-proclaimed specialist in Graph Adversarial Technology who was fooled by a mock news article into spending a small fortune on researching image recognition technology to improve the reliability of Gardemeks.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>January 14, 2026</color>
Travelers need to visit the designated photo-taking spots to complete photo-taking challenges. Two new photo-taking spots will be added each day for the first five days of the event.

<color=#ffd680>February 14, 2026</color>
This is the heart-shaped chocolate I developed after studying with Chef Escoffier for so long. Please, you must accept it!
Of course, I also added some creative touches of my own. Baking is just like engineering, they both thrive on a little innovation!
That's not all. I've got another little surprise in store. Any idea what it might be?
Here's a hint: its aroma is richer than chocolate, and its color is more vibrant than the curtains of an opera house...

When Lepine-Pauline spent a small fortune on researching image recognition technology to improve the reliability of Gardemeks, Charlotte persuaded her to begin mass production of image recognition lenses and to venture into the Kamera industry.

customize.name: "Special Analysis Zoom Lens"
customize.desc:
A new type of Kamera accessory developed to enhance image recognition capabilities.

After equipping this accessory, a normal Kamera can quickly adjust its focus, allowing it to capture images of your travels so you can record precious memories at a moment's notice.

customize.text:
A prototype created by Lepine-Pauline. The "Kamera Lens for Image Recognition Sample Collection" is designed for high-fidelity image capture and analysis.
Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland
After Lepine-Pauline modified the Kamera Lens for Image Recognition Sample Collection and turned it into a high-precision zoom photography assistant, it became popular in the film industry of Fontaine. After the new-generation product hit the market right as the Kamera lens was evolving, many directors and merchants began to cooperate with Lepine-Pauline, and she became a rising supplier in the film industry. People trusted her devices, so she was chosen to help build Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, an amusement park based on the films, located on the banks of Fontaine.

customize.name: Sequence of Solitude
customize.desc: A mechanical longbow purpose-built for long shots and silent kills. Its twang is swallowed up amidst the night, the note lengthy and cold.

customize.text:
Lepine-Pauline gave this prototype to the Traveler and Paimon. Many years ago, a weapon research team at the Fontaine Research Institute developed a prototype to push the limits of long-range bow performance. Then, the Maison Gardiennage adopted muskets as their standard issue and stopped ordering bows. A sci-fi film about "Mechanically Enhanced Warriors" borrowed that bow as a prop. The invisible protagonist, "The Prophet," used it to silently take down all sorts of enemies.
Shutterflash lens
A lens created by Lepine-Pauline. It captures every movement and expression perfectly, even when the subject's moving really fast.
Ninette
Lepine-Pauline's assistant, who tests the Shutterflash lens.
